papers.title: LLM Pretraining Shapes a Generalizable Manifold: Insights into Cross-Modal Transfer to Time Series
papers.what: Explains why a frozen LLM transfers to time-series forecasting: a linear probe on frozen states decodes realistic trajectories with no paired supervision, so pretraining builds a reusable manifold and fine-tuning only projects onto it.

papers.title: Rethinking RL for LLM Reasoning: It is Sparse Policy Selection, Not Capability Learning
papers.what: Token-level analysis shows RL changes only 1-3% of positions, all at high-entropy decision points and within the base model's top-5, so RL selects among existing solutions rather than teaching new ones.

papers.title: Personalizing Embodied Multimodal LLM Agents over Long-term User Interactions (POLAR)
papers.what: Memory-augmented embodied agent that splits a multimodal knowledge graph into semantic (facts) and episodic (events) layers to personalize behavior across many sessions.
papers.builds_on: Memory Mechanisms Survey (Huang 2026), Agent AI Survey (Durante 2024)

papers.title: Code as Agent Harness
papers.what: Position-and-survey paper reframing code as the substrate that unifies agent reasoning, action, environment modeling, and execution-based verification, organized into interface, mechanism, and scaling layers.
